messages:
mike: Drafting a new SLA-aware region routing proposal. Idea: prefer customer region, but if p95 latency exceeds 350ms, route to fallback region or model-variant depending on tier. Need feedback on telemetry + console UX and quota implications.

ashley: Quick Q — how do we show "why" the request was routed in the console? per-request trace with routing_reason? :thinking: 

jordan: Sketch of a simple policy DSL to discuss (pseudo-yaml):
```
policy:
  priority:
    - region_affinity
    - latency_threshold: 350ms
    - fallback: [model_variant: quantized, other_region]
  constraints:
    - customer_tier: enterprise -> region_strict: true
    - data_residency: eu -> region_match: eu_only
```
Short version: enterprise customers stay in-region unless manual opt-in. Non-enterprise can fail over to other regions or to quantized variants.

ellie: Rollout UX thought: canary by "customer tier + region" slice. Start with 5% of non-enterprise EU traffic to new routing, monitor quality regressions + cost. Console should have an easy toggle per region/tier for canary.

leena: Data locality note: Dedicated and Private deployments must NOT cross regions for failover (contracts + compliance). Also: quota/billing semantics — if we route to fallback region, which region's quota gets charged? We should avoid double-charging.

mike: Good point. Prefer charging origin region's quota and only expose cross-region usage in infra billing for accounting. Need input from finance on legal.

sre-bot: probe-alert: /probe/us-west spiked 503 errors at 2026-02-11T12:34:10Z, degraded routing away from us-west for 2m. See /alerts/2345.

ashley: Telemetry reqs: add trace tags `routing_reason`, `selected_region`, `latency_estimate_ms`, `fallback_variant`. Add dashboard tile: per-region routing decisions over time + SLO breach correlation. Also need link from a trace to the policy version used.

jordan: On model variant fallback, prefer same-region quantized variant first. Only cross-region if no compatible variant or region probes failing. Pseudocode: 
```
if region_latency.p95 > 350 and customer.tier != 'enterprise':
  try serve(variant='quantized', region=origin)
  if fail: route(region=nearest_healthy_region, variant=compatible_family)
else:
  serve(primary_model, origin_region)
```
We should encode this in the DSL so the routing engine is deterministic and explainable.

ellie: Deployment plan: doc + small canary (5%) for 2 weeks, check quality and cost. If stable, ramp by region. Need owners for policy + console + telemetry.

mike: Owners: Jordan -> DSL + runtime hooks (PR by EOD Fri). Ashley -> console mock and trace UX. Leena -> confirm quota/billing semantics and legal constraints. Ellie -> canary plan + sig schedule. I'll link design doc here shortly and create a follow-up thread for canary instrumentation. Thanks all :thumbsup:

leena: Ack, will coordinate with finance/legal.

jordan: Will open the DSL repo PR and include unit tests for priority ordering.

ashley: I'll mock a call-trace pane and a canary toggle control by tomorrow.

mike: Awesome — I'll post the design doc link in the morning and tag reviewers.
